Create one original production-source pixel-art asset for Retold's Aender, consistent with the approved material-study reference. Restrained dusty lilac/plum timber, pale mineral, and mint accents. Actual low-resolution pixel sprite style, crisp uniform squares, limited purposeful palette, no antialiasing, blur, bloom, realistic/PBR lighting, text, labels or watermark. Intended logical size 16x16; fill the canvas as specified.
Specific asset: One refined Aenderite ingot item sprite on a genuine transparent 16x16 logical-pixel square. Centered low oblique classic ingot silhouette, flat mint-green top plane, desaturated teal side plane and deep teal underside outline, tiny pearly highlight. Industrial refined metal rather than glowing gemstone. Limited crisp pixels, one pixel breathing room, no shadow, labels, gradients or background.
sources.origin: Retained generated custom-device/mineral artwork; statically packed at native size

sources.name: aender_sand
sources.prompt: Create one completely ORIGINAL static 16x16 logical-pixel Aender SAND texture for Retold, enlarged as crisp pixel art. Use the original Aender Sand color family shown in the supplied palette card: dominant deep muted denim blue #45517a, quiet darker #344263 and lighter slate-blue #596895 grains. This replaces the developer's hand-drawn texture; do not reproduce any hand-drawn pixel arrangement. The world uses an inverted Overworld palette, so familiar yellow/beige sand becomes dark denim blue. Match vanilla Minecraft's fine sand texture rhythm: tiny one-pixel grains, occasional paired pixels, low contrast, gently irregular natural distribution, no dirt pebbles, horizontal layers, large blocky mosaic clusters, bubbles, waves, footprints or ornament. Keep the sand visibly finer and calmer than speckled blue dirt. EXACTLY SIXTEEN BY SIXTEEN logical uniform square pixels, not a finer32/64 texture reduced later. Full opaque square, flat even lighting, seamless repeat on opposite edges, no edge border, margin, perspective, text, antialiasing, gradients, bloom, PBR rendering, or animation frames. No Minecraft texture pixels or extracted assets.
sources.origin: Built-in image_gen; replaces developer-drawn sand at developer request
